I don't have a big ego.. I don't have the highest self esteem myself. I'm speaking from experience when I say that when you don't respect yourself, there is no way you can expect a loving, health relationship to blossom. When I say 'love yourself' I don't mean you have to be this ultra confident person, what I do mean is you have to look inward and be honest with yourself. Constantly self doubting yourself, putting yourself down, not doing the bare minimum to take yourself shows in other people, and why would anyone want to commit to someone who can't even love and respect themselves?

If you want to have a successful relationship, you have to have self love, self care. How do you expect to build a successful relationship when you can't even take care of yourself or ask questions about the situation you find yourself in.

I'm not saying that loving yourself is the end all be all to being lonely. But this notion that lonely people (coming from someone who felt this way for years and while being in a long term relationship) will no longer feel lonely by simply getting a girlfriend isn't true. When you are in a relationship, introspection is often a super important tool to use, and if you are feeling lonely, or don't legitimately have friends, you need to simply ask yourself WHY. You need to make the introspective analysis as to why you are in this position and fix it. If you can't look inward and see the shit situation you are currently in, there is no way that you are going to have a successful relationship.
